title: "Lesson 1: Covenants"

<iframe src="lesson-template.pdf" width="100%" height="700px">

**Here would go a map showing racially restrictive covenants that I will have identified through research at the deeds office in Roanoke**

```{r}
library(sf)
library(tigris)
library(dplyr)

roanoke <- places(state = "VA", cb = TRUE) %>%
  filter(NAME == "Roanoke")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(roanoke) +
  geom_sf(fill = "gray", color = "black") +
  ggtitle("Roanoke, Virginia")
```

```{r}
library(leaflet)

leaflet(roanoke) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = "gray",
    fillOpacity = 0.3,
    color = "black",
    weight = 1
  ) %>%
  setView(lng = -79.9414, lat = 37.2710, zoom = 11)
```
